notes: Five items queued from the 2026-09-10 poll, all five read.

coverage.note: The two Lurie rent-emergency stories name no address. The teacher-housing financing story names 750 Golden Gate Avenue and 1620 7th Avenue only in a list of district sites, and the Candlestick story's one hit, 415 Natoma, is a passing comparison. The Westfield story's 420 Taylor, 731 Market and 25 Taylor are the buyer's earlier purchases, reported before.

findings.description: Westfield sold 818 Mission Street, with its neighbour at 814, to two LLCs linked to Seven Equity Group for about $15.5 million combined, per city records, having bought the pair for $42 million nearly twenty years earlier. The ground-floor Denny's closed in late 2024 and the space has been empty since. The date is the article's; it reports the sale as just recorded.

extra.buyer: two LLCs linked to Seven Equity Group

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “Former owner of downtown’s dead mall just sold two other buildings at a huge discount,” 10 September 2026

raw.text: Westfield bought the side-by-side properties at 814 and 818 Mission St. nearly 20 years ago for $42 million — and just offloaded them

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 818 MISSION ST → parcel 3705008; sf-parcels has blklot 3705008 active, 315–315 JESSIE; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1907. EAS puts 816, 818 MISSION ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 816.

publish.note: Published on the existing page /san-francisco/south-of-market/mission-street/816/ as sf-standard-2026-09-10.

findings.description: The six-storey Bulletin Building at 814 Mission Street, built in 1925 as the newsroom of the San Francisco Evening Bulletin, was sold by Westfield with its neighbour at 818 to entities linked to Seven Equity Group for about $15.5 million combined. The article names the building and its year plainly, and both agree with what the roll holds (1925, six storeys), so the building's name and completion year go into the building block.

raw.text: Next door, the six-floor Bulletin Building at 814 Mission St. was built in 1925 and served as the newsroom for the defunct The San Francisco Evening Bulletin.
